probe_history.reason: curl GET of https://postbahnhof.com/ (the domain most third-party listings/search engines cite as this venue's 'official website') returns 200, but its own retained content (nav: 'Das Café', 'Der Beutel', 'Flächen', 'Nachhaltigkeit'; <title>'Startseite - BNP Postbahnhof'; outbound links to patrizia.ag and realestate.bnpparibas.de) proves it is a commercial real-estate/office-space marketing site for the building, operated by BNP Paribas Real Estate / PATRIZIA AG — not a live-music-venue presence at all, and it exposes no event/programme content whatsoever. curl GET of https://www.fritzclub.com/ (the historic in-building club brand) returns 200 but is a generic WordPress site ('Exclusive Membership Club and Social Community') containing zero occurrences of the word 'Berlin' anywhere in its retained HTML — not this candidate's presence either. curl of https://postbahnhof-berlin.de/ redirects (303) to an ad-network domain-parking endpoint (p2-1.afp24.net) before hitting a Cloudflare bot-challenge page — a parked/expired domain, not a live site. No genuine first-party official website for this candidate could be identified after checking every plausible domain surfaced by search.
